messages.subject: RE: Caspian / Stratton Energy – Master SaaS Agreement (mark-up attached)
messages.htmlBody:
James,

Our mark-up is attached (tracked). The main points from Stratton are:
1. Liability cap – we've moved it to 200% of trailing fees;
2. Uptime – Stratton need 99.9% given this feeds their regulatory reporting;
3. Hosting – UK only, please;
4. Payment terms – 60 days to match their AP cycle; and
5. Termination for convenience – they'd like the ability to exit on 90 days' notice.

Most of the rest is fine. Let's get a call in the diary once you've digested it.

Regards,
Adam
